title: F1SimParamsSchema
description: Single source of truth for ApexAI F1 Sim training parameters, reward formulations, and system settings

parameters.label: Window Laps
parameters.description: Lowest-time N-lap window average of valid push laps. Stored per model per track, improve-only.

parameters.label: Track Training Laps
parameters.description: Target laps when establishing the track baseline before advancing to quali training.

parameters.label: Improvement Multiplier
parameters.description: Linear multiplier applied to lap time delta when faster than reference.

parameters.label: Non-Improvement Multiplier
parameters.description: Penalty multiplier applied to lap time delta when slower than reference.

parameters.label: Crash Penalty
parameters.description: Deliberately lenient penalty so the AI agent explores limits safely during initial track exploration.

parameters.label: Handoff Ramp Laps
parameters.description: Geometric transition ramp into strict quali penalties upon handoff (0 = instant switch).

parameters.label: Slow Multiplier
parameters.description: Linear penalty per second slower than the track reference on push laps.

parameters.label: Upside Scale (c)
parameters.description: Base reward scalar in c * (e^(d * delta) - 1).

parameters.label: Upside Exponent (d)
parameters.description: Exponential growth rate with respect to seconds faster.

parameters.label: Upside Delta Clamp
parameters.description: Maximum seconds delta evaluated into exponential upside to prevent float32 explosion.

parameters.label: Battery S3 Weight
parameters.description: State of charge weight read at the start of Sector 3 on the out lap.

parameters.label: In Lap Delta Limit
parameters.description: Allowed delta over reference after subtracting pit lane transit time.

parameters.label: Out Lap Delta Limit
parameters.description: Allowed delta over reference on tyre preparation out lap.

parameters.label: Subtract Pit Time
parameters.description: Whether pit lane speed limiter transit time is subtracted from in/out lap delta.

parameters.label: Over-Limit Base (a)
parameters.description: Scalar for over-limit exponential penalty: a * (e^(b * excess) - 1).

parameters.label: Over-Limit Exponent Mode
parameters.description: Derived uses b = 1 + 1/a; manual uses inout.over_b_manual.

parameters.label: Manual Exponent (b)
parameters.description: Manual exponent used when over_b_mode is set to manual.

parameters.label: Over-Limit Penalty Cap
parameters.description: Maximum ceiling for in/out lap delta penalty.

parameters.label: Readiness Weight
parameters.description: Reward weight for achieving optimal tyre/brake thermal windows and battery charge.

parameters.label: Wear Reward Weight
parameters.description: Weight applied to allowance minus wear percentage.

parameters.label: Wear Allowance: Soft
parameters.description: Allowed tyre wear percentage for soft compound on out lap.

parameters.label: Wear Allowance: Medium
parameters.description: Allowed tyre wear percentage for medium compound on out lap.

parameters.label: Wear Allowance: Hard
parameters.description: Allowed tyre wear percentage for hard compound on out lap.

parameters.label: Wear Allowance: Intermediate
parameters.description: Allowed tyre wear percentage for intermediate wet compound.

parameters.label: Wear Allowance: Wet
parameters.description: Allowed tyre wear percentage for full wet compound.

parameters.label: Wear Out-Lap Multiplier
parameters.description: Wear term scale multiplier on out laps. No wear penalty applied on push laps.

parameters.label: Push Crash: Corner
parameters.description: Penalty for crashing in corner apex or turn zone.

parameters.label: Push Crash: Intermediate
parameters.description: Penalty for crashing in high-speed transition or chicane entrance.

parameters.label: Push Crash: Straight
parameters.description: Penalty for crashing on full-throttle straightaway.

parameters.label: In/Out Lap Crash
parameters.description: Severest penalty: crashing on non-competitive in/out preparation lap.

parameters.label: Wipe Segments Count
parameters.description: Number of preceding mini-segments wiped of positive rewards upon crash if yellow or red.

parameters.label: Red Segment Delta Threshold
parameters.description: Time delta threshold slower than personal best green segment to mark as red.

parameters.label: Cycle Sequence
parameters.description: Periodic lap sequence executed in simulation.

parameters.label: Cold Start Initial State
parameters.description: Start with cold tyres, cold carbon brakes, and pit lane limiter active.

parameters.label: Restart On Crash
parameters.description: Reset car to pit launch upon fatal crash or off-track terminal incident.

parameters.label: Failed Laps Count Toward Print
parameters.description: Include aborted and crashed laps when checking textual.print_every_laps trigger.

parameters.label: Print Every Laps
parameters.description: Interval of completed laps between detailed status telemetry blocks printed to terminal.

parameters.label: Interactive Paced Lap Duration
parameters.description: Wall-clock simulated duration of one lap in NO speed mode.

parameters.label: LOW Mode Refresh Interval
parameters.description: Period between lightweight telemetry snapshots pushed to dimmed UI.

parameters.label: HIGH Mode Terminal Print Interval
parameters.description: Period between one-line console updates when webview is off.

parameters.label: Restore LOW Mode Hotkey
parameters.description: Global hotkey (Shift + ] on US layout) to wake up and restore webview in LOW mode.

parameters.label: Governor Reserve CPU Cores
parameters.description: Physical CPU cores left unoccupied for OS and responsive system operations.

parameters.label: Governor Thermal Ceiling
parameters.description: Maximum package temperature before worker threads ramp down.

parameters.label: RAM Budget Ceiling
parameters.description: RAM consumption limit before replay buffer is compressed or workers throttled.

parameters.label: Throttling Detection Drop
parameters.description: Throughput drop at constant workers indicating hidden thermal CPU throttling.

parameters.label: Battery Power Worker Factor
parameters.description: Multiplier for worker thread count when running on un-docked DC battery power.

parameters.label: Autosave Lap Target Percentage
parameters.description: Trigger rolling autosave checkpoint every N% of phase target laps.

parameters.label: Autosave Wall Clock Interval
parameters.description: Trigger rolling autosave checkpoint every N minutes of wall-clock time.

parameters.label: Autosave Min Throttle Window
parameters.description: Minimum delay between consecutive autosave writes to avoid disk thrashing.

parameters.label: Validate Finite Weights & Optimiser
parameters.description: Reject and drop checkpoints containing NaN or Inf before overwriting rolling slot.

parameters.label: Shutdown Checkpoint Timeout
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait for clean learner save on exit before force-closing.

parameters.label: Equivalence Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum absolute difference required between plain Python and compiled kernel outputs on fixed seed.

parameters.label: Benchmark Verification Steps
parameters.description: Number of evaluation steps run on fixed seed during variant benchmarking.

parameters.label: Track Map Max FPS
parameters.description: Strict maximum frame redraw rate to keep idle CPU low.

parameters.label: Live Chart Window History
parameters.description: Maximum number of past lap data points retained in memory for live charts.

parameters.label: WebSocket Hub Port
parameters.description: Localhost TCP port for Tauri core and Python learner WebSocket bridge.

parameters.label: Heartbeat Ping Interval
parameters.description: Interval for heartbeat exchanges. Learner triggers emergency save if lost for 3s.

parameters.label: Target Lap Time Expression
parameters.description: Safe math expression evaluated over variables: last_target, last_best_avg, last_best_lap.

parameters.label: Default IO Group Size
parameters.description: Neuron count allocated per active input/output toggle group.
